name: Select documents
description: Review what retrieval found: exclude instruments with a reason, add ones it missed, tick provisions in or out, read the full text. Every decision is logged as provenance.

config.label: Warn below this many documents
config.help: The low-document-count guardrail. 0 turns it off.

config.label: Warn when excluding above score
config.help: Excluding a document scoring at least this much asks the person to confirm.

config.label: Adding a document selects its preamble
config.help: Preambles are kept out of the retrieval index. The old dashboard selected them on manual add and then silently dropped them; this makes the choice explicit.
